you know how kath works? you collect 10 stacks of flamma on your buff bar. there are onyl a few ways to get flamma: e3 seeds 1 stack on all kath cards. exalt adds 3 stacks to your cards in hand after drawing, OE adds 5 stacks. And posse draws a card and adds the stack to it. So posse is your most reliable way to add stacks to your buffs and to cards. without posse, she's even slower thna now, and she's already too slow

plus she can't hold a candle in nightmare anymore as the damage is just too high even for her sustain which is pretty good if you build tank kath. We all knew she'd eventually go the way of the dodo, but in combination with the "all-future-realms will-be-divine" announcement she's in a terrible place. absolutely no new chaos teammates for her
